type.description: Bug classification type. Extended in v2.0 to include concurrency, security, and state corruption bugs.

forbidden_shortcuts.description: Implementation approaches that should NOT be used as fixes

regression_tests_to_keep.description: Existing tests that should be kept and not broken by the fix

bug_type_descriptions.RACE_CONDITION: Concurrent operations produce wrong result due to timing
bug_type_descriptions.SECURITY_ISSUE: Security vulnerability or permission boundary violation
bug_type_descriptions.DEADLOCK_OR_LIVELOCK: Process stuck in deadlock or livelock waiting for resources
bug_type_descriptions.MEMORY_LEAK: Memory or resource not properly released
bug_type_descriptions.TIMING_ISSUE: Race between operations causing inconsistent state
bug_type_descriptions.DATA_RACE: Simultaneous access to shared data without proper synchronization
bug_type_descriptions.ATOMICITY_VIOLATION: Operation that should be atomic is not
bug_type_descriptions.ORDERING_VIOLATION: Operations executed in wrong order causing incorrect result
bug_type_descriptions.CONSISTENCY_ISSUE: Data or state inconsistent between operations
bug_type_descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_VIOLATION: Repeated operation produces different result than single execution
bug_type_descriptions.AUTHORIZATION_BYPASS: User can perform actions without proper authorization
bug_type_descriptions.INPUT_VALIDATION_BYPASS: Invalid input not properly validated before processing
bug_type_descriptions.STATE_CORRUPTION: System reaches an invalid or corrupt state
